title: QuickMate
description: Chain destruction with one click, rapid batch building — elevate your construction efficiency to new heights.​
body:
### **QuickMate**
![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.8-green) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-API-lightgrey) ![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-API-lightgrey) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange) A powerful Minecraft Fabric chain mining mod providing intelligent scanning and batch destruction features
## ✨ Features ### 🔍 Intelligent Scanning System - **Multiple Scanning Strategies**: Supports irregular, horizontal line, vertical line, staircase, 3x3 tunnel, and various other scanning modes. - **Precise/Fuzzy Matching**: Choose to destroy only identical blocks or similar block types. - **Real-time Preview**: Highlights the range of blocks to be destroyed with selection boxes. - **Configurable Maximum Count**: Limits the maximum number of blocks for a single chain destruction (1-2048). ### ⛏️ Chain Destruction - **Server-Side Authority**: All scanning and destruction logic is executed server-side to prevent cheating. - **Automatic Batch Destruction**: After destroying one block, automatically destroys all matching adjacent blocks. - **Game Mode Adaptation**: - Survival Mode: Generates drops normally. - Creative Mode: Option to generate drops or not. - **Efficient Performance**: Utilizes concurrent data structures, supporting multiple players simultaneously. ### 🎮 User-Friendly - **Key Bindings**: Toggle chain mining on/off with a single keystroke. - **Configuration Interface**: Beautiful graphical configuration interface. - **Multi-language Support**: Supports both Chinese and English. - **Real-time Notifications**: Optional function activation/deactivation prompts. ## 📦 Installation ### Prerequisites - Minecraft 1.21.8 - [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [NeoForge API]() ### Installation Steps 1. Download the latest version of QuickMate `.jar` file. 2. Place the file into the `.minecraft/mods` folder. 3. Launch the game to start using it. ## 🎯 Usage ### Basic Operations 1. **Open Configuration Interface**: Press the default key (can be modified in control settings). 2. **Enable Chain Mining**: Toggle the status via the configuration interface or key binding. 3. **Aim at Target Block**: Look at the block you want to mine. 4. **Start Mining**: Break the block normally; the chain function will automatically take effect.
